cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I held my breath like you. Very calming, this new-flat routine. Stay while I try it again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was avoiding the paint smell. You need to breathe normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, fresh air first. Open the window with me before you go; I haven't been here on my own yet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll wait while you put the kettle on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay until it boils. Then I'll try making one cup without getting yours out.

reason: Make copied confidence create a specific misunderstanding in the same emotional task; preserve B contribution and avoid turning vulnerable requests into rubric explanations.
